totalCount.description: Total number of plans matching the request, across all pages.

items.description: A single plan record as it appears in a paginated plans listing.

id.description: Server-assigned unique identifier for the plan.

tenantId.description: Identifier of the tenant that owns this plan.

payerId.description: Identifier of the payer this plan is associated with. Extracted server-side from `data.payer` at creation time.

data.description: The plan's domain data, validated against the Plan JSON schema at creation/update time.
The current page of plan records (at most 10).
